<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915193_theRebbe_723" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915193_theRebbe_723__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B'Siyata D'Shmaya.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Toldos,</t>
    <t s="2">Mevarchim HaChodesh and Erev Rosh Chodesh Kislev, 5745</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the verse "And Yonasan said to him: Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant," connecting it to the concept of nullification and the drawing down of a new light.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"And Yonasan said to him: Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant."</t>
    <t s="1">And the Tzemach Tzedek explains in his maamar beginning with these words,</t>
    <t s="2">that Dovid</t>
    <t s="3">is the aspect of Malchus,</t>
    <t s="4">which includes all the souls of Israel,</t>
    <t s="5">for all of Israel are children of kings.</t>
    <t s="6">And the concept of "you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant" is,</t>
    <t s="7">that through the vacating</t>
    <t s="8">(the absence)</t>
    <t s="9">of the place of your seat,</t>
    <t s="10">[which is] nullification,</t>
    <t s="11">through this there will be "you will be missed,"</t>
    <t s="12">the drawing down of the remembrance</t>
    <t s="13">from above.</t>
    <t s="14">For remembrance is a very lofty aspect</t>
    <t s="15">(as will be explained below).</t>
    <t s="16">And this is the connection of "you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant" with "tomorrow is the new moon,"</t>
    <t s="17">because on the eve of Rosh Chodesh there is concealment and hiding of the moon,</t>
    <t s="18">until that in the moment before the molad not even a point remains of it,</t>
    <t s="19">and through this there is afterwards</t>
    <t s="20">(tomorrow)</t>
    <t s="21">a new month,</t>
    <t s="22">the renewed birth of the moon,</t>
    <t s="23">the drawing down of a new light from the sun to the moon,</t>
    <t s="24">which did not shine in it previously.</t>
    <t s="25">And so too is it with Israel, who are compared to the moon,</t>
    <t s="26">that through their nullification,</t>
    <t s="27">a most exalted light is drawn into them,</t>
    <t s="28">a new light.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the new light drawn down is called "remembrance," because it is the light of Ein Sof that is beyond relation to worlds, drawn specifically through nullification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this drawing down of the new light is called "you will be missed,"</t>
    <t s="2">[which is] remembrance,</t>
    <t s="3">because,</t>
    <t s="4">the drawing down of light that relates to worlds</t>
    <t s="5">(even a light that is above worlds but relates to worlds)</t>
    <t s="6">is not a true novelty,</t>
    <t s="7">and a new light is the light of Ein Sof that is beyond relation to worlds.</t>
    <t s="8">And this is that the drawing down of this light is called "you will be missed,"</t>
    <t s="9">because remembrance is in Ein Sof that is beyond relation to worlds.</t>
    <t s="10">And as explained elsewhere,</t>
    <t s="11">that just as in man the concept of remembrance applies only to something that is not significant in his eyes</t>
    <t s="12">(to the extent that it is easy to forget it),</t>
    <t s="13">so too is it above,</t>
    <t s="14">that the concept of remembrance is in Ein Sof that is beyond relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="15">for everything before Him is considered as nothing.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is "you will be missed, for your seat will be vacant,"</t>
    <t s="17">that the drawing down of the light that is beyond relation to worlds</t>
    <t s="18">("you will be missed")</t>
    <t s="19">is specifically through nullification</t>
    <t s="20">("for your seat will be vacant").</t>
    <t s="21">For when a person's service is connected with his own existence</t>
    <t s="22">(an existence of holiness),</t>
    <t s="23">the drawing down that is drawn through the service is from the aspect of light that relates to worlds</t>
    <t s="24">(existence),</t>
    <t s="25">and in order for there to be a drawing down of the light that is beyond relation to worlds,</t>
    <t s="26">for everything before Him is considered as nothing,</t>
    <t s="27">it is through nullification,</t>
    <t s="28">"for your seat will be vacant."</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
